title: List ignores the Technician choice and Tech View brings it back
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ralph Edwards) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST NT4 Technician Filter Memory") has exactly three Approved work orders: {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17630) led by {Technician-A}, {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17631) led by {Technician-B}, and {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17632) with no lead.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off and Search is empty. Asset on Site has nothing selected.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  3. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  4. Click the Technician filter and tick {Technician-A}.
  5. Click outside the Technician filter list to close it.
  6. Read the groups and rows shown.
  7. Click List in the display switcher.
  8. Read the rows shown and the filters in the filter bar.
  9. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  10. Read the Technician filter and the groups shown.
  11. Click Asset on Site and tick No.
  12. Click outside the Asset on Site list to close it.
  13. Reload the page.
  14. Read the Technician filter and the Asset on Site filter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: only {Technician-A}'s group shows, holding {Work-order-1}.
  • Step 8: List shows every work order of {Customer-A}, {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3}, as if no technician were chosen, and List's filter bar shows no Technician filter.
  • Step 10: the Technician filter still shows {Technician-A} chosen, and only {Technician-A}'s group shows, holding {Work-order-1}.
  • Step 14: the Technician filter is remembered exactly as Asset on Site is. If Asset on Site still shows No after the reload, the Technician filter still shows {Technician-A} chosen. If Asset on Site was cleared by the reload, the Technician filter is cleared too. Write down which happened.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R15b and the Feature Overview's new exceptions sentence (added in version 52 on 14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward ruling after Sasha Grosman's staging review follow-up), read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R15b: “List does not offer the Technician filter and stays as in production. Switching to List while technicians are chosen shows List as if none were chosen; switching back to Tech View or Board View brings the choice back. The choice is remembered the same way as the other filters.”
  • Feature Overview (the two exceptions): “Imported work orders are one exception: they open in List only (S1-R13a, S1-R13b). The Technician filter is the other: Tech View and Board View offer it and List does not (S1-R15).”
